$$
\begin{aligned}{c}_{32} & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ -2 & 0 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 & 4 & -1 \\ 1 & -2 & 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =1\cdot 4+2\cdot (-2) \\  & =4-4 \\  & =0.\end{aligned}
$$

source.value:
Here, the first factor is a $3 \times 1$ matrix and the second factor is a $1 \times 2$ matrix. 

There is $1$ column in the first matrix and $1$ row in the second matrix, so the product is well defined:

$$
\bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{3} \times {\color{green}\fbox{1}} {\color{green}\checkmark} {\color{green}\fbox{1}} \times \bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{2} = 
	\bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{3} \times \bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{2}
$$

Computing the product, we have

$$
\eqalign {
    \left\lbrack
    \matrix {
       -1 \
 	0 \
        -2
    }
    \right\rbrack

    \left\lbrack
    \matrix {
        2 & -5
    }
    \right\rbrack

	&= 

    \left\lbrack
    \matrix {
        (-1)\cdot 2 & (-1)\cdot (-5) \
        0\cdot 2 & 0\cdot (-5)\
        (-2)\cdot 2 & (-2)\cdot (-5)
    }
    \right\rbrack \[5pt]

	&=

    \left\lbrack
    \matrix {
       -2 & 5 \
       0 &  0 \
       -4 &  10 
    }
    \right\rbrack 
}
$$
